lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Ah—sorry! I thought I had both cups. Your cards didn't get wet, did they?

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Just the table. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: I am. I was bringing drinks to the practice group before they started without me.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: They can get their own drinks, you know.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: I know. I'm trying to be useful, but now I've got tea on my sweater and everyone's cleaning up after me.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Could you watch my deck a second? I need two hands and a towel.

choices.label: Offer your jacket while she dries off
choices.reply: Thank you. You can have it back as soon as I find somewhere to hang this sweater.

choices.label: Help clean up and tell her nobody's upset
choices.reply: Oh. Good. I always assume I've ruined everyone's day when I spill something.

choices.label: Move the playmat and give her a little privacy
choices.reply: You noticed I needed space. That's really kind of you.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Excuse me—could you hold that box? I can't quite reach the last row.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Sure. What's in it?

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Sleeves for the beginner night. I promised I'd help set up the tables.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You're doing all that by yourself?

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Trying to. This shelf and my sweater are both conspiring against me today.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: I'm asking them to move the supplies lower next time. This is ridiculous.

choices.label: Hold the box steady while she gets it down
choices.reply: Thanks! I've got it from here. ...Probably. No, really, I've got it.

choices.label: Suggest moving the beginner supplies to an easier shelf
choices.reply: Oh! You're right. Other people must struggle with this shelf too.

choices.label: Tease her about declaring war on the shelving
choices.reply: It's an unfair fight. The shelf has a height advantage.

openingByFlag.luna_jacket: You lent me your jacket last time. I still have it... clean, I promise. Could you help me with this shelf?
openingByFlag.luna_calm: You were so calm when I spilled everything. Maybe you can help me with something that doesn't involve liquids?
openingByFlag.luna_lookaway: You looked away when my sweater got wet. That was really considerate. Could you help me reach this?

events.title: The Stretch That Broke the Silence

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Yes! I finally got the Energy count right. Wait—don't move that box!

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: You rebuilt the deck?

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: I took out the cards everyone kept insisting I needed. I've lost two practice games already.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: And how do you feel about that?

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Strangely good. At least they were my mistakes. ...Oh, I stood up too fast and knocked the deck over.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Could you help me gather the cards? I want to put them back in order myself.

choices.label: Help gather the cards without rebuilding her deck
choices.reply: Thanks. I know where every card goes. For once, I really do.

choices.label: Ask what she learned from the two losses
choices.reply: That I need a better opening hand plan. And maybe fewer copies of my favorite Pokémon.

choices.label: Tell her you're impressed she trusted her own idea
choices.reply: Really? I was scared you'd say I should put the old combo back in.

openingByFlag.luna_help: You helped me last time without making me feel useless. I'm trying the high shelf again... poorly.
openingByFlag.luna_shirt: You mentioned my shirt before. I tried a different one. It still doesn't behave.
openingByFlag.luna_tease: You teased me last time. Please be nice while I fail at reaching things again.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: I asked the shop owner to lower the supplies shelf. She said yes. It took me all week to ask.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: That sounds like a win.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: It did. Then someone picked up my deck in the middle of a turn to 'help' me.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: What did you do?

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Asked for it back. My hands were shaking, but I said it. And I finished the match.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: I don't mind help. I just want to be the one who asks for it.

choices.label: Tell her she handled the situation well
choices.reply: It felt awful for five seconds. Then it felt wonderful.

choices.label: Ask how she wants you to help during matches
choices.reply: Ask me first. Even if I'm clearly losing. Especially then.

choices.label: Admit you like how determined she's becoming
choices.reply: I feel determined, until I open my mouth. But I think that's still progress.

openingByFlag.luna_cover: You always cover for me. Even when I make it hard.
openingByFlag.luna_realize: I’ve been thinking about what you said in the shop. About why people look.
openingByFlag.luna_compliment: You said I looked good even when I was struggling. I’ve been replaying that a lot.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: I brought an extra playmat today. And I checked the chair legs. Twice.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: Prepared for anything?

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Not anything. I still dropped my deck on the way in. But I picked it up and kept going.

lines.speaker: Protagonist
lines.text: How did the tournament go?

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Lost the first round, won the second. My list, my decisions. I didn't apologize once.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: Would you play with me again next week? I'd like you there, even if I lose.

choices.label: Make plans to keep playing together
choices.reply: Then I'll bring the playmat. You bring a deck that doesn't go easy on me.

choices.label: Tell her you'd like it to be a date
choices.reply: A date? ...Yes. I'd like that very much. We can still bring our cards, right?

choices.label: Let her set the pace and choose what comes next
choices.reply: Thank you. I want to see what we can become without rushing to decide everything.

openingByFlag.luna_same: You said I was still the same person. I’ve been holding onto that.
openingByFlag.luna_time: You told me it was okay to take time. I think I’m ready to talk about it more.
openingByFlag.luna_notice: You admitted you noticed. And you still wanted to keep talking to me.
